---
name: Change Request
about: Request a change to an existing feature in NutriSmart AI
title: "[CHANGE] "
labels: change
assignees: ""
---

**Current behavior**
Describe the current behavior of the feature.

**Desired behavior**
Describe what you want the feature to do after the change.

**Reason for change**
Explain why this change is necessary (e.g., usability issue, policy update, performance improvement).

**Impact analysis**
- [ ] This change affects the **frontend** (Flutter app)
- [ ] This change affects the **backend** (FastAPI / Supabase)
- [ ] This change affects the **database schema**
- [ ] This change requires a **migration**
- [ ] This change is **backward compatible**

**Priority**
- [ ] Critical (blocks other work)
- [ ] High (important but not blocking)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (future consideration)

**Additional context**
Add any relevant screenshots, logs, or references here.
